cities.name: Rome
cities.local_food_tip: Try classic Roman dishes — pasta carbonara, cacio e pepe, thin crust pizza, gelato and espresso in local trattorias. 🍝🍕🍨
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏛️ Visit Colosseum & Roman Forum → Walk through historic alleys → ☕ Coffee and pastry in a traditional café.

Afternoon: ⛪ Explore Vatican City (St. Peter’s Basilica, Vatican Museums) → 🍽️ Lunch: pasta or local Roman dish.

Sunset: 🌇 Stroll through Trastevere or Piazza Navona for evening vibes and sunset light over historic façades.

Night: 🌙 Dinner in a trattoria or osteria, gelato by the street, relaxed walk under city lights — mix of ancient city charm & modern life.

ideas: 🌸 Cherry‑blossom and spring blooms near ancient ruins — perfect for sightseeing.
☀️ Mild weather for walking long routes across the city without summer heat.
🎭 Outdoor small concerts or cultural events in piazzas.
🌞 Early sightseeing, afternoon rest then evening walks with gelato under warm nights.
🍷 Light dinners late, night city life and relaxed summer vibes.
🌇 Sunset from viewpoints — historic skyline bathed in golden light.
🍂 Historic streets with autumn colours — nice for atmospheric photo walks.
🍲 Hearty Italian meals, pasta and wines as temperature cools.
🏛️ Museums and indoor visits in case of rainy days.
☕ Warm drinks, cozy cafés — ideal after cold walks near ruins.
🏠 Quiet city atmosphere, fewer tourists — peaceful sightseeing.
🎄 Festive decorations and Christmas markets around major piazzas.

public_transport_tips: 🚇 Use metro, trams or buses to navigate across city quickly.
🚶 Historic centre walkable — ideal for exploring on foot.
🎟️ Consider multi‑day transport pass if visiting many sites in few days.
🚲 Bicycles or scooter‑rental can help za kratke distance i istraživanje užih ulica.

city_events.name: Rome Summer Night Walks
city_events.description: 🎶 Evening cultural events, music in piazzas, open air terraces and vibrant summer atmosphere.

cities.name: Florence
cities.local_food_tip: Try Tuscan specialties — ribollita soup, bistecca alla fiorentina, local wines and olive oil based dishes. 🍲🥩🍷
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏛️ Visit Uffizi Museum or Accademia (David) → Walk along historic streets toward Duomo → ☕ Coffee in central square.

Afternoon: 🌉 Stroll over Ponte Vecchio, explore artisan shops → 🍽️ Lunch: Tuscan dish with local wine.

Sunset: 🌇 Walk to Piazzale Michelangelo for panoramic city view at golden hour.

Night: 🌙 Dinner in trattoria, local wine, gelato and night stroll through lit‑up historic centre.

ideas: 🌿 Mild weather — perfect for long walks between historic sites and river Arno.
🎨 Outdoor art markets, street musicians and cultural events.
🌸 Blooming gardens and soft light — great for photos.
🌞 Crowded museums in mornings, then evening strolls by Arno with gelato.
🎶 Street music, open‑air dining and lively summer nights.
🌇 Sunset viewpoints and relaxed walks under warm sky.
🍁 Vineyards near city show autumn colours, ideal for countryside trips nearby.
🥘 Hearty Tuscan meals, wine tasting weekends and calm city walks.
🏛️ Museums and indoor visits for cooler/rainy days.
🔥 Warm dishes, cozy cafés — perfect after chilly walks.
🏙️ Historic centre under soft winter light — nice for quiet sightseeing.
🛍️ Shopping artisan goods and souvenirs in less crowded shops.

public_transport_tips: 🚶 City centre compact — najviše na noge ili bicikle.
🎟️ Tram/tren/bus za okolinu ili jednodnevne izlete izvan centra.
🚲 Bicikli su super za reku Arno i okolinu — istražuj opušteno.
🚗 Za vinske ture ili sela oko Toskane — auto je zgodan.

city_events.name: Florence Wine & Art Autumn
city_events.description: 🍷 Wine tastings, art events, city culture and Tuscan heritage celebration.

cities.name: Tuscany / Chianti Region
cities.local_food_tip: Chianti wines, rustic bread, olive oil, local cheeses, cold cuts and hearty countryside meals — ideal after vineyard visits or countryside walks. 🍷🧀🍞
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🚗 Drive to vineyards, take wine‑tour and tastings among rolling hills and vines → 🍇 Sample local Chianti wine and regional snacks.

Afternoon: 🏘️ Visit small hilltop villages — enjoy panoramic views, historic churches and countryside atmosphere → 🍽️ Lunch: rustic Tuscan meal with local wine.

Sunset: 🌇 Watch sunset over vineyards and hills — serene atmosphere of countryside.

Night: 🌙 Stay in agriturismo or rural guesthouse — dinner with local dishes, wine, olive oil specialties and peaceful rural night.

ideas: 🌿 Vines wake up, countryside green — perfect za šetnje po prirodi i opuštanje.
🚶 Biciklom ili pešice kroz sela i brežuljke, svež vazduh i mir.
🍷 Ranovremensko vino, lokalne delicije i tišina daleko od gradova.
🌞 Rano jutro za vinograde, plodne livade i topli dani uz vino i prirodu.
🏖️ Moguć odlazak i na more — bliži primorju, pa kombinacija vinograda + more.
🔥 Večernji obroci u ruralnim tavernama, domaće vino i mir.
🍇 Berba grožđa, festival vina, lokalne manifestacije posvećene vinu i hrani.
🍁 Jesenja svetlost i boje brežuljaka — savršeno za fotografije i opuštanje.
🥘 Domaća hrana, topla jela, vino i mirna atmosfera sela.
🔥 Kamin, domaća hrana i vino — idealno za beg iz gradske gužve.
🌧️ Šetnje mirnim selima, tišina i priroda, zimska rustična atmosfera.
🏡 Opuštanje u agriturismu, lokalna hrana i tišina noći.

public_transport_tips: 🚗 Auto je najpraktčniji za istraživanje sela i vinograda — fleksibilnost putovanja.
🎫 Neki vinogradi nude ture + prevoz — dobra opcija ako ne želiš da voziš.
🚶 Pešačenje ili bicikl za lokalne izlete — klima i pejzaž su idealni za to.
📝 Planiraj unapred — ruralne ceste su uske, a signal i prevoz nisu uvek česti.

city_events.name: Chianti Harvest & Wine Festival
city_events.description: 🍇 Festival berbe grožđa i vina, degustacije, lokalna hrana i selo‑kultura.

cities.name: Venice & Veneto Region
interests: Canals, Historic Canals & Romantic Gondola Rides 🚤
cities.local_food_tip: Try seafood, risotto al nero di seppia (squid ink risotto), cicchetti (small snacks), local white wines — perfect after canal‑walks or boat rides. 🍝🐟🍷
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🌉 Gondola ride through canals → Explore historic center and bridges → ☕ Coffee near canal side.

Afternoon: 🏛️ Visit St. Mark’s Basilica, Doge’s Palace, walk narrow alleys → 🍽️ Lunch: lagoon seafood or Venetian dish with wine.

Sunset: 🌇 Boat ride to nearby islands (Murano, Burano) for sunset over lagoon and unique island architecture.

Night: 🌙 Dinner in small bacari (Venetian taverns), wine, cicchetti and night stroll through illuminated canals — dreamy Venetian night scenery.

ideas: 🌸 Mild weather, calm canals — perfect za istraživanje bez gužve.
🚤 Isolated gondola vožnje i mirne šetnje uz kanale.
🍷 Lagano vino i snack‑ovi pokraj vode u opuštenoj atmosferi.
☀️ Ranom zorom gondola, popodnevno odmori, večernje šetnje pod mesečinom uz kanale.
🍧 Lagan ručak, sladoled i lagane večere uz vodu sa pogledom.
🎭 Moguće letnje kulturne ture, koncerti ili manifestacije na trgovima i lukama.
🍂 Kanali u zlatnim tonovima — savršeno za fotkanje i mirne šetnje.
🔥 Topla hrana, vino i lagane taverne nakon dana istraživanja.
🏛️ Manje gužve u muzejima i istorijskim objektima — više mira.
🌫️ Magla nad kanalima, tišina i gotovo puste ulice — mistična atmosfera.
🔥 Domaće vino, topla jela i komfor u malim restoranima ili bacarima.
🎨 Unutrašnje posete — muzeji, istorija, galerije — idealno za hladnije dane.

public_transport_tips: 🛶 Vaporetti (vodeni autobusi) su glavni prevoz u gradu i okolnim ostrvima — planiraj karte unapred.
🚶 Mnoge delove istorijskog centra je najbolje pešice — uske uličice i mostovi.
🎟️ Turističke vodene karte mogu da uštede ako planiraš više vožnji brodovima.
🚤 Za obližnja ostrva — brod ili trajekat, proveri sezonske rasporede.

city_events.name: Venice Carnival & Lagoon Events
city_events.description: 🎭 Historic carnival, masquerade, Venetian traditions — unique cultural experience by the lagoon.

cities.name: Sicily (Sicilian Islands & Coastal Towns)
cities.local_food_tip: Fresh fish, seafood pasta, citrus fruits (lemons, oranges), local wines and olive oil — flavors of the Mediterranean sun and sea. 🍋🐠🍷
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏖️ Swim or relax on beach or coastal cliffs → Breakfast by sea with coffee and pastry.

Afternoon: 🏛️ Visit ancient ruins, historic towns or small villages — explore Sicilian culture and history → 🍽️ Lunch: seafood or regional dish with local wine.

Sunset: 🌇 Coastal walk, cliff‑view or harbor promenade for sea sunset and soft Mediterranean light.

Night: 🌙 Dinner with local seafood, wine, seaside breeze; possibility of night strolls by water or small local festivals — island charm under stars.

ideas: 🌿 Pleasant weather — good for exploring ruins, towns and coast without summer heat.
🚶 Coastal and countryside walks, sea breeze and calm atmosphere.
🍊 Fresh citrus harvest, local markets — tasty seasonal produce.
🏝️ Beach, sea, sun — classic island holiday under warm Mediterranean sky.
🍧 Fresh seafood dinners, local wine, seaside relaxation and nightlife in coastal towns.
🚤 Boat rides, exploration of small coves and island‑hopping possibilities.
🍂 Mlađa sezona, manje gužve — mirnije plaže i čistija atmosfera.
🥘 Rich seafood & citrus dishes, warm wine, relaxed pace away from masovne sezone.
📷 Scenic light for photos — more mekana svetlost, opušteni dani i priroda.
🌬️ Blaga klima, mir, odlična prilika za istraživanje istorije i kulture ostrva bez gužve.
🔥 Lokalna jela, domaće vino, topla atmosfera u pitoresknim mestima pored mora.
🚶 Šetnje uz more, čist vazduh, priroda i zimski mir u mediteranskom ambijentu.

public_transport_tips: ⛴️ Trajekti i lokalni brodovi povezuju ostrva i ostrvska mesta — planiraj rutu unapred.
🚶 Centar gradića i plaže su često blizu — pešice je najjednostavnije za istraživanje.
🏍️ Skuter ili auto iznajmljivanje može da pomogne za istraživanje ostrva i ruralnih delova.
🎫 Kombinovane karte za brod + prevoz + turističke ture često štede — proveri opcije.

city_events.name: Sicily Summer Island Festival
city_events.description: 🌊 Sea‑side concerts, boat parties, local food & cultural events under Mediterranean sky.
